english.title: Drive vehicle in Bristol Airport without current licence and valid driving permit
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) drove a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE..), at Bristol Airport, without first being in possession of

(A)_[a current licence]_
(B)_[relevant driving permit issued by Bristol Airport Limited]_
(C)_[a current licence and a relevant driving permit issued by Bristol Airport Limited]_

necessary to drive the vehicle or drive the vehicle where it was being driven
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 4.32 and 3.4 of the Bristol Airport Byelaws 2012 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
